questions.knowledge_point: 教室物品 chair / desk / blackboard
questions.question: 「椅子」的英文是（　）

questions.knowledge_point: 教室物品 chair / desk / blackboard
questions.question: 「黑板」的英文是（　）

questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 in / on / under
questions.question: 书在桌子上，应说（　）
options: The book is on the desk.
The book is in the desk.
The book is under the desk.
questions.answer: The book is on the desk.

questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 in / on / under
questions.question: 「猫在椅子下面。」的英文是（　）
options: The cat is under the chair.
The cat is on the chair.
The cat is in the chair.
questions.answer: The cat is under the chair.

questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 in / on / under
questions.question: in 表示「在……里面」。

knowledge_summary.point: 教室物品 chair / desk / blackboard
knowledge_summary.core_concept: chair 椅子、desk 书桌、blackboard 黑板。chair 和 desk 都在教室里，blackboard 是老师写字的地方。
common_mistakes: desk 与 table 混用（table 一般指餐桌）。
knowledge_summary.tips: 书桌说 desk，餐桌说 table。

knowledge_summary.point: 方位介词 in / on / under
knowledge_summary.core_concept: on 在……上面、in 在……里面、under 在……下面。The book is on the desk. 书在桌子上。
knowledge_summary.key_formula: Where is the …? — It's on / in / under the …
knowledge_summary.tips: 上面 on、里面 in、下面 under。
